# BT25-078 Gazimon — Digimon, Lv.3, Purple, DP 1000, Cost 3.
# Traits: Mammal, Iliad, TS. Attribute: Virus.
# [When Moving][On Play] Reveal top 3; add 1 card with [Three Musketeers] in text to hand,
# OR you may place 1 [Three Musketeers] trait card as bottom digivolution card; rest to bottom.
# Inherited <Retaliation>. Alt-digivolve Lv.2 Purple, or Lv.2 [TS]/[Three Musketeers]-text / Cost 0.
# Printed "you may place" applies only to the trait pick; reveal/return are mandatory.
# Hand eligibility uses full "[X] in text" per official Q6379.
card: BT25-078
name: Gazimon
kind: digimon
level: 3
form: Rookie
color: [purple]
cost: 3
dp: 1000
traits: [Mammal, Iliad, TS]
attribute: Virus
alt_paths:
  - kind: digivolve
    from:
      all_of:
        - level_eq: 2
        - color_is: purple
    cost: 0
  - kind: digivolve
    from:
      all_of:
        - level_eq: 2
        - any_of:
            - trait_has: TS
            - in_text_contains: "Three Musketeers"
    cost: 0
effects:
  - when: [on_move, on_play]
    # [When Moving] is self-scoped ("when THIS Digimon moves from breeding");
    # the engine's on_move dispatch is a board-wide observer scan, so gate the
    # on_move timing on the moved permanent being this Digimon (EX11-038 idiom).
    timing_conditions:
      - when: on_move
        condition: { event_permanent_is_source: true }
    summary: "[When Moving][On Play] Reveal 3; add 1 [Three Musketeers]-in-text card to hand OR place 1 [Three Musketeers]-trait card as bottom source; rest to bottom"
    process:
      - reveal_top_deck: { of: you, count: 3, bind_as: revealed }
      - select_effect_choice:
          labels:
            - "Add a [Three Musketeers] card to hand"
            - "Place a [Three Musketeers] trait card as bottom digivolution card"
          bind_as: branch
          prompt: "Add 1 [Three Musketeers] card to hand, or place 1 [Three Musketeers] trait card as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card?"
      - if:
          condition: { equals: [branch, 0] }
          then:
            - choose_from_reveal:
                of: you
                filter: { in_text_contains: "Three Musketeers" }
                destination: hand
                bind_as: hand_pick
                prompt: "Add 1 card with [Three Musketeers] in its text to your hand"
      - if:
          condition: { equals: [branch, 1] }
          then:
            - choose_from_reveal:
                of: you
                optional: true
                filter: { trait_has: "Three Musketeers" }
                destination:
                  bottom_source_of: { target: this }
                bind_as: source_pick
                prompt: "Place 1 [Three Musketeers] trait card as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card"
      - place_remainder_on_deck: { of: you, position: bottom }
  - scope: inherited
    kind: grant_keyword
    keyword: Retaliation

labels: Add a [Three Musketeers] card to hand
Place a [Three Musketeers] trait card as bottom digivolution card

# BT26-073 Aegiochusmon: Dark — Digimon, Lv.5, Purple/Red, DP 8000, Cost 8.
# Traits: Shaman, Iliad, TS + (Rule) Wizard. Form Ultimate. Attribute: Vaccine.
# Printed digivolve box: Purple Lv.4 / cost 4; Red Lv.4 / cost 4;
#   [Digivolve] [Aegiomon]: Cost 3.
# Special play: Assembly -2: Lv.4 or lower Digimon card w/[Chronomon] in text
#   or w/[TS] trait. (Official Q&A: the level cap applies to BOTH branches.)
#
# Printed card text (official Bandai DB — data/card_bundles/BT26-073.md):
#   [On Play] [When Digivolving] By deleting this Digimon or returning 1
#     [Shaman] or [TS] trait card from your trash to the bottom of the deck,
#     delete 1 of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon.
#   [On Deletion] You may play 1 [TS] trait card with a play cost of 5 or less
#     from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
#   (Rule) Trait: Has [Wizard] Type.
#   Inherited: <Security A. +1>.
#
# DCGO C# reference: DCGO/Assets/Scripts/CardEffect/BT26/Purple/BT26_073.cs
#
# ─── DCGO crosscheck (per clause) ────────────────────────────────────────────
# Alt-digivolve: TopCard.EqualsCardName("Aegiomon"), cost 3 (no level gate).
# Assembly: 1 element, IsDigimon && Level <= 4 && (HasText("Chronomon") ||
#   HasTSTraits), reduceCost 2. → `kind: assembly` (trash materials,
#   stack_under), filter `in_text_contains: Chronomon` OR `trait_has: TS`.
# Shared OP / WD (optional:false, skippable): SetIntSelection over the PAYABLE
#   costs {Delete this Digimon | Return 1 [Shaman]/[TS] from trash (offered only
#   when the trash holds one) | Don't use}. Delete branch is paid only if the
#   deletion succeeded; trash branch is a canNoSelect:true pick (declining =
#   not paid). If paid: MANDATORY (canNoSelect:false) delete of 1 opponent
#   level-5-or-lower Digimon.
#   → modal (two shapes by payability, BT26-082 idiom) + delete source /
#   optional select_trash + return_trash_list_to_deck_bottom, gated delete.
# On Deletion (optional): [TS] && HasPlayCost && cost <= 5 && can play; a
#   From hand / From trash / Don't play location pick, then PlayByEffect free.
#   → select_union_zone [hand, trash] optional + play_union_bound_free (one
#   prompt spanning both zones; declining = "Don't play").
# Inherited: ChangeSelfSAttackStaticEffect(+1) → SecurityAttackPlus 1.

card: BT26-073
name: "Aegiochusmon: Dark"
kind: digimon
level: 5
color: [purple, red]
cost: 8
dp: 8000
traits: [Shaman, Iliad, TS, Wizard]
form: Ultimate
attribute: Vaccine

alt_paths:
  - kind: digivolve
    from: { level_eq: 4, color_is: purple }
    cost: 4
  - kind: digivolve
    from: { level_eq: 4, color_is: red }
    cost: 4
  - kind: digivolve
    from: { name_is: "Aegiomon" }
    cost: 3
  - kind: assembly
    materials:
      - filter:
          all_of:
            - kind: digimon
            - level_lte: 4
            - any_of:
                - in_text_contains: "Chronomon"
                - trait_has: TS
        zones: [trash]
        stack_under: true
    cost: 2

effects:
  # ─── [On Play][When Digivolving] delete this OR return 1 [Shaman]/[TS] from
  #     trash → delete 1 opponent level 5 or lower Digimon ──────────────────
  - when: [on_play, when_digivolving]
    summary: "[On Play][When Digivolving] By deleting this Digimon or returning 1 [Shaman] or [TS] trait card from your trash to the bottom of the deck, delete 1 of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon"
    process:
      - if:
          condition:
            count_gte:
              filter:
                of: you
                zone: [trash]
                any_of:
                  - trait_has: Shaman
                  - trait_has: TS
              n: 1
          then:
            - select_effect_choice:
                bind_as: cost_mode
                labels:
                  - "Delete this Digimon"
                  - "Return 1 [Shaman] or [TS] trait card from your trash to the bottom of the deck"
                  - "Don't pay the cost"
                prompt: "Will you pay the cost?"
            - if:
                condition: { equals: [cost_mode, 0] }
                then:
                  - delete_permanent: { target: source }
                  - if:
                      condition: { effect_deleted_any_own_digimon: true }
                      then:
                        - select_opponent_permanent:
                            bind_as: victim
                            filter:
                              all_of:
                                - kind: digimon
                                - level_lte: 5
                            prompt: "Delete 1 of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon"
                        - delete_permanent: { target: victim }
            - if:
                condition: { equals: [cost_mode, 1] }
                then:
                  - select_trash:
                      of: you
                      bind_as: returned
                      optional: true
                      filter:
                        any_of:
                          - trait_has: Shaman
                          - trait_has: TS
                      prompt: "Return 1 [Shaman] or [TS] trait card from your trash to the bottom of the deck"
                  - if:
                      condition: { binding_present: returned }
                      then:
                        - return_trash_list_to_deck_bottom:
                            of: you
                            cards: returned
                        - select_opponent_permanent:
                            bind_as: victim2
                            filter:
                              all_of:
                                - kind: digimon
                                - level_lte: 5
                            prompt: "Delete 1 of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon"
                        - delete_permanent: { target: victim2 }
          else:
            - select_effect_choice:
                bind_as: cost_mode_b
                labels:
                  - "Delete this Digimon"
                  - "Don't pay the cost"
                prompt: "Will you pay the cost?"
            - if:
                condition: { equals: [cost_mode_b, 0] }
                then:
                  - delete_permanent: { target: source }
                  - if:
                      condition: { effect_deleted_any_own_digimon: true }
                      then:
                        - select_opponent_permanent:
                            bind_as: victim3
                            filter:
                              all_of:
                                - kind: digimon
                                - level_lte: 5
                            prompt: "Delete 1 of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon"
                        - delete_permanent: { target: victim3 }

  # ─── [On Deletion] may play 1 [TS] card (play cost <= 5) from hand or trash
  #     without paying the cost ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  - when: on_deletion
    summary: "[On Deletion] You may play 1 [TS] trait card with a play cost of 5 or less from your hand or trash without paying the cost"
    process:
      - select_union_zone:
          of: you
          zones: [hand, trash]
          bind_as: ts_pick
          optional: true
          filter:
            all_of:
              - trait_has: TS
              - any_of:
                  - kind: digimon
                  - kind: tamer
              - play_cost_lte: 5
          prompt: "You may play 1 [TS] trait card with a play cost of 5 or less from your hand or trash without paying the cost"
      - play_union_bound_free:
          binding: ts_pick

  # ─── Inherited <Security A. +1> ────────────────────────────────────────────
  - kind: grant_keyword
    scope: inherited
    keyword: SecurityAttackPlus
    value: 1
    summary: "[Inherited] <Security A. +1>"

cards.source_utf8:
card: P-156
name: "Future Potential!"
kind: option
# Printed color is WHITE (official Bandai DB + cards.json color id 4). White
# never color-matches a battle-area permanent, so without a Tamer the card is
# unusable — exactly the printed gate: "While you have a Tamer, you may
# ignore this card's color requirements" (modeled as use_requirement below).
color: [white]
cost: 2

# "While you have a Tamer, you can ignore this card's color requirements."
# Native Option `use_requirement` participates in both the play action mask and
# play_option_from_hand legality. This is narrower and more faithful than a
# stale IgnoreColorRequirement flood_gate for this card.
use_requirement:
  any_field_permanent:
    of: you
    kind: tamer

effects:
  - when: main
    condition:
      any_permanent:
        of: any
        kind: tamer
    summary: "[Main] Choose 1 Tamer; you may play 1 Digimon with the same color and play cost 3 or less from hand or trash"
    process:
      - select_any_permanent:
          bind_as: chosen_tamer
          filter:
            kind: tamer
          prompt: "Choose 1 Tamer"
      - select_effect_choice:
          labels: ["From hand", "From trash"]
          bind_as: zone_choice
          prompt: "Play from hand or trash?"
      - if:
          condition: { equals: [zone_choice, 0] }
          then:
            - select_hand:
                of: you
                bind_as: picked_hand
                optional: true
                filter:
                  kind: digimon
                  play_cost_lte: 3
                  color_matches_binding: chosen_tamer
                prompt: "You may play 1 Digimon with the same color as the chosen Tamer from your hand"
            - play_from_hand_free: { of: you, hand_index: picked_hand }
      - if:
          condition: { equals: [zone_choice, 1] }
          then:
            - select_trash:
                of: you
                bind_as: picked_trash
                optional: true
                filter:
                  kind: digimon
                  play_cost_lte: 3
                  color_matches_binding: chosen_tamer
                prompt: "You may play 1 Digimon with the same color as the chosen Tamer from your trash"
            - play_from_trash_free: { of: you, hand_index: picked_trash }

  # "[Security] You may play 1 Tamer card from your hand without paying the
  #  cost. Then, add this card to your hand."
  #
  # The "you may" governs ONLY the Tamer play. The "add this card to your hand"
  # tail is unconditional, so the clause itself is mandatory (optional: false) —
  # the player must never be able to decline the whole Security effect and skip
  # the mandatory add-to-hand. The Tamer-play optionality lives entirely in the
  # inner select_effect_choice Play/Decline branch.
  #
  # PUPPETS-G017 (partially resolved 2026-05-08): the engine-side outer-tail
  # rewrap keeps a mandatory sibling tail parked behind any nested pending
  # selection. The card-shaped adoption uses the proven BT22-042 pattern:
  #   - count_gte guard so no prompt installs when no Tamer is in hand;
  #   - explicit visible Play/Decline branch (select_effect_choice) because the
  #     optional sub-effect has a follow-up hand selection;
  #   - the mandatory add_this_option_to_hand tail is a sibling step that always
  #     resolves whether the optional play is performed, declined, or skipped.
  - when: on_security
    optional: false
    summary: "[Security] You may play 1 Tamer from hand free; then add this card to hand"
    process:
      - if:
          condition:
            count_gte:
              filter:
                of: you
                zone: [hand]
                kind: tamer
              n: 1
          then:
            - select_effect_choice:
                labels: ["Play Tamer", "Decline"]
                bind_as: tamer_play_choice
                prompt: "Play 1 Tamer card from your hand without paying the cost?"
            - if:
                condition: { equals: [tamer_play_choice, 0] }
                then:
                  - select_hand:
                      of: you
                      bind_as: picked_tamer
                      filter:
                        kind: tamer
                      prompt: "Choose 1 Tamer card to play from your hand"
                  - play_from_hand_free: { of: you, hand_index: picked_tamer }
      # "Then, add this card to your hand." — mandatory tail.
      - add_this_option_to_hand: {}

SelectHand.prompt: You may play 1 Digimon with the same color as the chosen Tamer from your hand

SelectTrash.prompt: You may play 1 Digimon with the same color as the chosen Tamer from your trash

Triggered.summary: [Main] Choose 1 Tamer; you may play 1 Digimon with the same color and play cost 3 or less from hand or trash

SelectEffectChoice.prompt: Play 1 Tamer card from your hand without paying the cost?

SelectHand.prompt: Choose 1 Tamer card to play from your hand

Triggered.summary: [Security] You may play 1 Tamer from hand free; then add this card to hand
